reports.label: Ready properties
reports.budgetLabel: Up to AED 1.2 million, including fees
reports.intro: Completed homes selected around a strict total budget, with rental evidence, annual ownership costs and a transparent comparison.

recommendations.title: Emaar Golf Views A - the primary Emaar option
recommendations.body: The completed community, vacant listing and lower overall commitment provide room within the budget. Its one-bedroom format offers a focused entry into Emaar South.

recommendations.title: The Pulse Plaza B8 - a two-bedroom alternative
recommendations.body: The illustrated total leaves more budget flexibility than MAG 540, while the larger layout and operating amenities support a broader household use case.

recommendations.title: MAG 540 - prioritise space and budget discipline
recommendations.body: The furnished two-bedroom offering merits consideration, provided the final price and every fee keep the first-year commitment within AED 1.2 million.

reports.label: Off-Plan (Under Construction)
reports.intro: Under-construction homes screened for a total acquisition budget below AED 1.7 million, with payment obligations and fee treatment shown separately.

recommendations.title: Emaar Golf Fields - prioritise the master community
recommendations.body: The Emaar South setting, golf-oriented amenities and staged payment structure support its inclusion. Confirm the exact residence and current developer offer.

recommendations.title: Ellington Windsor House - consider design and specification
recommendations.body: Ellington provides a design-led alternative in the Residential District. Any resale selection should follow a full reconciliation of the seller payment ledger and total transfer obligation.

recommendations.title: Golf Trails - consider only a confirmed within-budget unit
recommendations.body: Current one-bedroom broker evidence fits the modelled cap, while Emaar live inventory starts higher. Proceed only if Emaar confirms the exact price, unit and payment schedule.

reports.label: Off-Plan (Under Construction)
reports.intro: A measured budget extension for Expo Living opportunities, supported by current Emaar unit records and complete payment schedules.

recommendations.title: Terra Woods - the priority premium comparison
recommendations.body: The selected Emaar unit has a published price, floorplan and dated 80/20 schedule. Expo Living provides a distinct proposition around the established Expo City destination.

recommendations.title: Terra Gardens - the lower total commitment
recommendations.body: The selected available unit offers an earlier published handover and a lower all-in planning total. It should be compared directly with Terra Woods on layout and payment timing.

recommendations.title: Extend the budget for a clear preference
recommendations.body: The additional commitment should be justified by the preferred residence, developer terms and location. Airport and Expo development support the long-term location case, not a promised appreciation rate.
